title: webclip scenario state
description: Domain state of the webclip behavior backend. Only live clips stay in the document: a deletion removes the clip from both clips and order, so every later read of the identifier answers 404.

clips.description: Live clips keyed by clip identifier.

order.description: Identifiers of live clips in insertion order.

clipId.description: Clip identifier allocated by the ids service.

url.description: The clipped page, echoed from the create request.

status.description: Lifecycle status. The backend never sets failed.

created_at.description: Creation time from the deterministic clock.

notes.description: Free-form note echoed from the create request.

account.description: The owning account and its quota limit.

account_id.description: Stable account identifier allocated once at initialize.

clips_limit.description: Clips the plan allows in total.
